why: This batch's neighbour deals repeatedly show one room sending pixels or repair to another while also promising or asking for something back, so the line between help given outright and help exchanged is where I expect to hesitate most.

multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-061: dropping it would read the item as pure attack calls and lose the flag-growth-into-neighbour-space strand.
